description: This file defines the SignatureV4 class used in the AWS SDK for signing requests using Signature Version 4, including methods for signing, presigning, and handling request headers and payloads.

classes.name: SignatureV4
classes.description: Class implementing AWS Signature Version 4 signing process, with methods for signing requests, presigning URLs, and handling headers and payloads.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS Signature Version 4, adding the necessary authorization headers.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for a request, allowing it to be used temporarily without exposing credentials.

methods.name: convertPostToGet
methods.description: Converts a POST request with form data into a GET request with query parameters for pre-signing.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Calculates or retrieves the payload hash for a request, considering unsigned payloads or streaming content.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload hash specifically for presigned requests.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonicalized path for signing, with proper URL encoding.

methods.name: createStringToSign
methods.description: Constructs the string to sign according to AWS Signature V4 specifications.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Prepares a request for presigning, adding security tokens if present.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Builds the canonical request components, including headers and payload hashes.

methods.name: getCanonicalizedQuery
methods.description: Creates a canonical query string from a parameters array for signing.

methods.name: convertToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts various date formats into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: convertExpires
methods.description: Calculates the URL expiration time, ensuring it is within allowed limits.

methods.name: moveHeadersToQuery
methods.description: Moves specific headers to query parameters for signing and removes illegal headers for v4a.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a PSR-7 request into components required for signing.

methods.name: buildRequest
methods.description: Constructs a PSR-7 request from parsed and signed request data.

methods.name: verifyCRTLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the 'awscrt' extension is loaded, required for v4a signing.

methods.name: createCRTStaticCredentialsProvider
methods.description: Creates a static credentials provider for the AWS CRT library.

methods.name: removeIllegalV4aHeaders
methods.description: Removes headers not allowed in AWS CRT v4a requests and stores them for later rerunning.

methods.name: CRTRequestFromGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle PSR-7 request into an AWS CRT request object.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Signs a request using the AWS CRT for asynchronous and asymmetric signing.

methods.name: presignWithV4a
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL using AWS CRT for async signature process.
